changes.summary: Add explicit ULP, statistical and MATLAB-epsilon comparison semantics, ignore_nan handling, sample/population variance and contract-declared multiplicative units.

matlab_eps.formula: atol + rtol*scale + multiplier*eps(max(|expected|,|actual|)) where eps is the IEEE-754 spacing at that magnitude

ulp.max_ulps: required non-negative integer; IEEE-754 bit distance; -0.0 and 0.0 are distance 0

normalization.sample: divide by N-1; MATLAB convention; fewer than two finite pairs is inconclusive when variance/stddev is declared

statistical.requirement: at least one threshold; unknown thresholds are contract errors

nonfinite_policy.ignore_nan: skip pairs where either side is NaN and record ignored_nan; infinities must still match sign and type

dimension.algebra: fixed SI/derived symbol table, products, quotients, integer powers, decimal scale constants

unit_definitions.shape: object mapping symbol to an expression over the built-in table or other declared units

semantics.matlab_expression_language: out of scope and refused: colon/linspace, implicit expansion, column-major reshape

operator_command.effect: evaluates the same engine, stores exact artifact bytes in the CAS, creates no verification and accepts no ChangeSet

limitations: the unit algebra is multiplicative only; affine and logarithmic units are refused
unit_definitions is contract-declared, not a shipped conversion database
MATLAB expression-language semantics are not implemented
real-data reproducibility gates do not establish agreement between different estimators
